title: Impact rulings
description: What an Epic's architecture change reaches: architecture-impact-analyst's result when the Epic's elaboration ends, on the Epics of the impact scope (the other Epics with a Task whose matrix elements name an entry the Epic changed). Consumed by the step after it (orchestrator/flows/architecture_impact.py), which restarts the elaboration of each Epic of the scope ruled elaborated-unbuilt and records every ruling and knock-on proposal.

Verdict.description: unaffected: nothing the item's specs or Tasks state about a changed entry is made wrong by the change. not-yet-elaborated: an Epic with no Story or Task beneath it. elaborated-unbuilt: Stories and Tasks exist, no build has started on any of them, and the change makes something they state about a changed entry wrong; the Epic is elaborated again. already-built: a build has started under it (a Task in progress or closed, or a Story in progress); a knock-on Task is proposed.

KnockOn.description: The repair an already-built item needs, proposed and never created: the built item it follows, the entry that changed and what will stop working.

repoPath.description: The repository of the stack the repair lands in (atw-matrix node stack:<id>).

beadId.description: An Epic of the impact scope, or an open Task of one that atw-matrix affected returned.

epicId.description: The Epic the item belongs to: the item itself for an Epic, the Epic `affected` names for a Task. The step after the analyst restarts this Epic when the verdict is elaborated-unbuilt.

rationale.description: One line on why, for every verdict.

entries.description: The changed entries the ruling rests on, by matrix id.

knockOn.description: The proposal for an already-built item; null for every other verdict.

searched.description: Each atw-matrix command run, with the id it was run for and what it returned, in one line each.

escalations.description: What could not be looked up or classified: a changed entry the matrix does not hold, an unreadable matrix or tracker, an item whose build state cannot be established.
